dimensions.language_runtime: Activation: actual stable .NET SDK 10.0.401 and runtime 10.0.12 on Linux x86_64; C#14/net10.0 foundation intended. Python 3.12.x, Git >=2.40,<3 and Bash5 governance remain current. Scaffold build and product tests NOT-RUN until separately published activation.
dimensions.web_host: DEV001 authorizes only a new single loopback Kestrel host with inert Razor MVC shell and a foundation health response. No business HTTP/MCP routes, custom workers, authentication or key creation. Host implementation and startup checks NOT-RUN at activation.
dimensions.frontend: No current frontend. DEV001 may build only an inert Razor shell with local styles; Bootstrap5/jQuery/Axios stay planned for later feature cards and are not fetched from CDNs.
dimensions.database: DEV001 may create new temporary isolated empty SQLite databases for foundation tests only, never choose/read/probe/import any old or real media database, backup or directory. SQLite execution NOT-RUN at activation.
dimensions.data_access: EFCore10 Code First remains the target. A fresh minimal offline SQLite test base may use pinned official Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite 10.0.12; no product entity schema, migrations or live store are approved. Package restore/build NOT-RUN at activation.
dimensions.background_jobs: No application worker or durable queue may start in this card. HostedServices are a retained future requirement with all product cancellation/retry/recovery tests NOT-RUN.
dimensions.cache_messaging: No Redis, external message broker or network cache. No new credential, saved auth or service account is required or permitted.
dimensions.testing: Fresh independent xUnit 2.9.3, xunit.runner.visualstudio 3.1.4 and Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.14.1 are intended from official NuGet; exact dependency locks and new temporary SQLite/filesystem plus inert-host tests are required for implementation delivery. Governance suites rerun at activation; old product tests and counts excluded.
dimensions.hosting_ci: Only the published isolated GitHub dot stage. CI provisions SDK from exact global.json, validates activation-only context/governance before source exists, then requires locked official NuGet restore, actual build/nonempty tests and inert-isolated host checks at implementation delivery. Main stays read-only.
dimensions.deployment_network: No release/deploy, real account/service/media access, paid AI, TMDB, credential generation or production permissions. Restore only from explicit official NuGet feed using approved tooling/cache; startup and tests use loopback and newly created temporary data only.
dimensions.ai_platform_shell: Actual independent author/test/reviewer executions declared; unavailable model recorded null. Current Linux x86_64/Bash only. Windows/macOS and PowerShell7 product acceptance remain NOT-RUN and require their own evidence.
